results.title: What To Expect From the August Jobs Report on Friday

results.content:
Bank of America analysts said in a research note on Wednesday that if the number of jobs added in the United States in August is smaller than expected, it’s more likely to affect bond yields than if the number comes in higher than expected.

The analysts said, however, that the jobs numbers are unlikely to be the deciding factor for a September rate increase from the Fed. Inflation data for August will probably be more influential.
